item.title: Jack's Story: dog rescued thanks to community response in Mineral County
item.description: Jack was first spotted in November in rough shape. Attempts to help him then were unsuccessful. Then, after months without a sighting, he resurfaced and is now receiving badly-needed love and care.

item.title: Finding 'green grass,' Bobby Kennedy energized to lead Montana as new coach
item.description: The excitement rolls on at the University of Montana, and on Thursday afternoon Bobby Kennedy was officially introduced as the 38th head football coach of the Montana Grizzlies.

item.title: Turnovers, cold shooting doom Montana Grizzlies in loss to Eastern Washington
item.description: The Montana men's basketball went cold in the second half, and saw turnovers doom them late as the Grizzlies fell to rival Eastern Washington 82-74 on Thursday evening at Dahlberg Arena.
